property_summary: For all callers and calldata, when the Owner calls Command forwarding any ETH, the reference contract never reverts (it always returns/continues even if the callee fails), whereas the mutant reverts whenever the callee call fails; thus the invariant is that invoking Command as Owner never reverts on the reference but can revert on the mutant for some callee that deliberately fails.
change_summary: Replace low-level call without checking return value with a checked call that requires success, causing Command to revert on callee failure instead of silently continuing.
